title: Auto Rebirth And More
features:
🔹 Auto Tycoon: Say goodbye to manual tycoon management! Our Script automates the process of running your tycoon, allowing you to effortlessly generate income and expand your empire. Sit back and watch your profits soar!

🔹 Auto Build Store: Building stores in e.l.f. UP has never been easier! Our Script takes care of the construction process for you, saving you time and effort. Watch your stores flourish as you expand your business!

🔹 Auto Rebirth: Level up at an incredible pace with our Auto Rebirth feature. Our Script automatically triggers rebirths for you, ensuring that you constantly progress and unlock new abilities. Reach new heights and become the ultimate tycoon!

🔹 And More: Our Script is packed with additional features to enhance your gameplay experience. From speed boosts to resource management, we've got you covered. Maximize your efficiency and become the tycoon you were destined to be!
